description: The login endpoint concatenates the username parameter directly into a SQL query, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and read the users table.

evidence.notes: Authenticated as user id 1 without a valid password.

impact: Full authentication bypass and disclosure of all user records, including password hashes.
proof_of_concept: POST /login username=' OR 1=1 -- password=x => HTTP 200 with session cookie for user id 1.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for all database access and enforce least-privilege database credentials.
steps_to_reproduce: Send a POST request to /login with username set to `' OR 1=1 --` and any password.
Observe that the response returns an authenticated session for the first user in the table.
Repeat with a UNION SELECT payload to exfiltrate rows from the users table.
title: SQL injection in login username parameter
